subject: 1093年大理国大理王府段氏宫室（建筑细部待考）
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset: a single transparent city-map building sprite for a realistic historical game.
Edit target IMAGE 1: Dali kingdom Duan clan royal residence courtyard in 1093. Change its MATERIAL RENDERING AND PALETTE, retaining its entire architectural layout, rectangular 18 by 14 ground plan, front gate on the lower-left long wall, the present balanced 2:1 dimetric ground directions, 45 degree yaw / 30 degree pitch orthographic camera, vertical columns, relative building heights and complete silhouette.
IMAGE 2 (Dali yamen) and IMAGE 3 (Dali manor) are the REQUIRED material and game-map style references. IMAGE 4 is an approved Song architectural baseline, ONLY for physically believable aged timber, gray clay tiles, rough stone and modest earth plaster; do NOT copy its landscape, perspective, temple subject or red color scheme.
Re-render image 1 convincingly in the same restrained realistic historical environment style as images 2 and 3. Roofs must be matte, low-saturation neutral gray unglazed clay tile with natural irregular wear, NOT blue glossy rows. Columns, beams and doors must be dark natural weathered brown timber, subtle visible grain, NOT bright orange or golden wood. Walls must be rough warm-gray earthen lime plaster with muted stone foundations, lightly weathered and maintained. Courtyard paving must be uneven natural gray stones, subtle soil in joints, no regular gleaming ivory tile floor. No bright contours or illustrated outlines, no shining white rim on every tile, no plastic, no toy, no miniature model, no tabletop, no glossy 3D render, no oversharpened HDR.
Reduce ornamental flowers to sparse subdued camellia shrubs with deep muted green leaves and a few small dusty red blooms. No neon yellow leaves, no bright flowerbed edging, no dense candy-colored garden. Preserve dignified broad rear reception hall, side wings and courtyard enclosure; architecture is original historical concept, not a reconstruction claim.
Light must remain soft natural upper-left daylight with short contact shadows to lower right. Natural low contrast, enough readable ambient shadow under eaves. Realistic matte microtexture, no blur or tilt-shift.
Ground base remains a THIN contact polygon, not thick pedestal. 18m long edge descends screen-right with slope +0.5, 14m short edge ascends screen-right with slope -0.5; no perspective convergence, no in-plane rotation. Keep the three visible ground contact corners clear. Keep entire roof, shrubs and ground edges intact with generous genuine transparent padding on ALL sides.
Output one isolated opaque building on true transparent RGBA background, landscape 1536x1024. No scenery, sky, gradient halo, fake checkerboard, cast-background shadow, floor outside footprint, people, text, signs, lettering, watermark, grid, modern objects, Qing imperial ornaments or golden roofs.
negative: 文字、水印、现代物、人物、背景、厚底台、亮橙柱、蓝亮瓦、描边、塑料/卡通/微缩模型、鲜亮花木、透视汇聚、裁切

同批通过审核的大理庄园；自然木色、旧瓦与克制花木参考

paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 第3次运行主代理及独立复核：旧版亮橙柱、蓝灰亮瓦、硬描边和鲜亮花木已淘汰；新图哑光棕木、低饱和灰陶瓦、粗糙土石墙及克制暗绿山茶与大理衙门/庄园材质一致，宋构approved基线仅作材质参考。主体完整，左上光/右下接触影，无字无人无现代物；右轴strict残差保留，形制待考，仍candidate。
